sessions.title: Azure AI Foundry - your go-to AI tool
sessions.description:
Azure AI Foundry brings  multiple services that enable developers to build amazing AI-powered solutions in a single unified experience for AI development on the Azure cloud platform.

For a single project you can now use Foundry for multiple tasks in the same environment and enables you better collaboration and faster development. These services are - just to name a few - deploying models from the catalog for real-time inference, deploying and testing generative AI models in Azure OpenAI service, using prompt flow to define workflows that integrate models, prompts, and custom processing, and many safety features, to fine-tuning and  several different SDK for language of your choice.


Session will give you a walk-through of Azure Foundry with AI Services and dive into  AI scenarios that could be enhanced by using AI tools.

sessions.title: Write Less Code by Writing More Code: C# Source Generators and Roslyn
sessions.description:
C# Source Generators and the Roslyn compiler sound intimidating, but they are actually a secret weapon for eliminating boilerplate code. In this talk, we’ll break down what source generators are, how they work under the hood, and how you can use them to write code that writes code for you at compile time.
We’ll start with a practical, step-by-step example by looking at a basic JSON serializer, and see how popular production libraries like Mapperly work under the hood. From there, we’ll dive into a real-world project I built called TypedIcons, a library that uses source generators to bring type-safe icons and IntelliSense to Blazor. You’ll leave with a clear understanding of how to make the compiler do the heavy lifting for your own projects.

speakers.bio: Amadej Glasenčnik is a .NET developer from Slovenia focused on C#, backend engineering, and developer tooling. He enjoys building practical software, exploring how development tools work under the hood, and sharing what he learns along the way. He is particularly interested in the .NET ecosystem, developer productivity, and turning ideas into working projects.
speakers.tagLine: Software Developer | Building stuff with .NET & C#

speakers.bio: Tomaž Kaštrun is a SQL Server developer and data scientist with more than 15 years of experience in the fields of business warehousing, development, ETL, database administration, and query tuning. He holds over 15 years of experience in data analysis, data mining, statistical research, and machine learning. He is a Microsoft SQL Server MVP for data platform and has been working with Microsoft SQL Server since version 2000. He is a blogger, author of many articles, a frequent speaker at the community and Microsoft events. He is an avid coffee drinker who is passionate about fixed gear bikes. In 2018 he co-authored book "SQL Server 2017 Machine Learning Services with R".
speakers.tagLine: SQL Server developer and data scientist
